subject: System Design
title: How Slack Scaled Real-Time Messaging
description: A 60-second lesson on How Slack Scaled Real-Time Messaging.

hook.text: Slack delivers billions of messages per day in real time to millions of concurrent users.

buildup.text: Each workspace is a separate channel namespace. Messages route through WebSocket connections.

discovery.text: Slack moved from a monolithic PHP app to a microservices architecture as they grew.

twist.text: Their biggest challenge wasn't message delivery — it was the database query load from search and history.

climax.text: Slack's journey shows that the bottleneck shifts as you scale. Today's solution is tomorrow's problem.

punchline.text: Scaling is a moving target, not a destination.

quiz.question: What was Slack's biggest scaling challenge?
options: Database query load from search and message history
